name: Core identity documents
one_line: A safety-only template for passports, government identity cards, birth and citizenship evidence, civil-status records retained as identity evidence, and privacy-protected contact exports. It recognizes enough structure to protect the material, writes no identity fields, proposes no folder dimensions, and falls through to Protected Records when no deeper user-accepted group exists.
design_cite: 00: "A scanned passport, tax statement, medical document, authentication key, or account record should enter a protected state immediately." It also states: "Contact formats such as VCF should yield names, organizations, email addresses, phone numbers, and address-book metadata, but should normally be privacy-protected rather than used to create folder proposals."

deterministic: a machine-readable passport or travel-document data-page structure with an issuing authority and document type, a portrait or signature region, labelled bearer attributes, labelled issue or expiry slots, and a machine-readable zone. The structure is the signal; a country name, portrait, date or identifier alone is not

a government photo-identity card structure with a named issuing authority, a labelled credential class, a portrait, labelled bearer attributes and a labelled document identifier or validity slot. A reverse-side barcode or machine-readable block corroborates the card but never proves the document type alone

a certified birth-record structure with a registry or vital-record authority, a certificate heading, labelled registrant and birth-event slots, registrar or informant roles, and a seal, stamp or certification block. One name, one date of birth or one seal is insufficient

a citizenship or naturalization certificate structure with a named authority, a certificate title, a labelled person-identification block, a citizenship or naturalization statement, and an issuance, seal or signature block

a government tax or social-identifier card whose own heading identifies the credential and whose issuer, holder-name and identifier slots appear together in the card structure. A name beside a long number on a tax return, payroll form or account statement is not this situation

a vCard container confirmed from content: a BEGIN:VCARD boundary, a version property, a formatted-name property and a matching END:VCARD boundary. RFC 6350 supplies the container grammar; the .vcf extension is only a routing clue

a multi-card address-book export with repeated complete vCard containers, or a structured contact export whose header cluster separates person-name fields from email, telephone, organization or address fields. The concrete CSV header catalogue is a later detector responsibility; one Name or Email column is never sufficient

an independently recognized core identity attachment inside a native email record. Attachment evidence can protect the enclosing message; the subject line, sender address and attachment filename cannot establish the document on their own
needs_llm: an angled, cropped, damaged, multilingual or partially legible card whose OCR lacks clear labels. Every case in this list is protected before interpretation and is eligible only for a local model or a model path explicitly permitted by user policy; it is never a default cloud dossier

distinguishing a civil-status certificate retained as current identity evidence from the same certificate retained as genealogical or historical research. The file's own use and accepted group context matter, but context must not copy a holder fact onto it

distinguishing a government identity credential from a professional licence, healthcare coverage card, vehicle registration, academic credential or financial record when all carry a name, issuing organization, identifier and validity date

a screenshot of a digital identity wallet or mobile credential. OCR and visible issuer/document structure can justify protection, but a screenshot cannot establish cryptographic validity or current status

a contacts CSV or scanned directory with non-standard headings, where the model must decide whether it is an address-book export, a CRM report, an event roster or an employer directory without exposing its rows outside the permitted model boundary

a mixed archive or packet containing an identity copy beside application, onboarding, loan, family-history or immigration records. The model may judge packet membership from a bounded local dossier but may not turn the packet's purpose into an identity fact
never_alone: a person's full name, home address, date of birth, portrait or signature. Bank statements, school records, insurance cards, professional licences and ordinary correspondence carry the same observations
a document-number-shaped, licence-number-shaped, tax-number-shaped or national-identifier-shaped token. Opaque numbers require their labelled slot and document structure

the words passport, identity, ID, licence, certificate, citizenship, contact or address book in a filename or body passage. Certificate is especially ambiguous across academic awards, professional licences, share certificates and cryptographic files
a government, registry, motor-vehicle authority, consulate or other issuer name. The organization can be a cited authority, employer, insurer, lender or correspondent; its labelled role is required

a seal, watermark, hologram, barcode, QR code, machine-readable characters or card-shaped rectangle by itself. Generic forms, tickets, membership cards and product packaging can share those visual items
source_type or extension alone: PDF, image, OCR, contacts, spreadsheet, email, archive, .vcf, .csv and .zip are routing signals, not identity evidence
a vCard extension without a confirmed container, or one FN, Name, Email, Phone or Organization field without the surrounding contact-export structure
missing EXIF, missing text layer, dense OCR or scanner metadata as proof that an image is an identity-document scan

a parent folder named IDs, Important Documents or Contacts, or membership in a bounded download or scanning session. Context can retrieve the file for review but cannot activate the template or create a fact
an issue date, expiry date or four-digit token. It cannot establish the document type, current status, holder or destination

work_types: driver licence or government photo ID
birth certificate or consular birth record
civil-status or name-change record retained as identity evidence
identity photograph attached to an accepted credential group
grouping_reasons: one credential across its front and back, rescans, photographs and corrected copies, joined through universal duplicate_family and version_family evidence rather than an identity field
one user-confirmed holder's protected document set. A repeated name is a retrieval clue only; this field-less template cannot write a holder fact or create a holder-named branch
one civil record and its certified copies or translations, with the translation remaining a related file rather than proof that either copy is authentic or current
one identity document as a protected member of an accepted application, onboarding, loan, legal or immigration packet without copying the packet's purpose or institution onto the document
one address-book export and its manifest, revisions or transferred copy, without creating a group or folder for every person or organization inside it
one sensitive record by itself. Core identity evidence does not need a large group before it is surfaced for protection

template.why: The identity schema intentionally declares no fields under D1 and PR-6, so there is no legal destination dimension to serialize. The empty order is also the safety recommendation: activation protects the record but does not unlock a deep filing tree, and contact exports are expressly excluded from folder proposals. A document-type or holder level would recreate fields the catalogue has deferred and would disclose the branch contents through the path itself. The user may attach a record to an already accepted protected group or create their own structure later; this node recommends no automatic depth and is not time-first.

collides_with.signal: A transcript, diploma or academic credential can carry a person's name, date of birth, photograph, seal and identifier. Academic attestation is established by a school, course/grade or award structure; core identity is established by a document whose own function is to prove civil identity or status. A name, seal, photograph or number proves neither side alone.

An identity copy is a common member of an application packet. The ID's own structure establishes only the protected core document; submission forms, portal records, checklists and accepted packet context establish the application situation. Packet purpose must not be copied onto the ID, and protection remains first whichever group holds it.

A professional licence and a government identity credential can both be authority-issued cards or certificates with a person's name, portrait, identifier, seal and validity slots. A profession, board and authorization-to-practise structure make the career-credential situation; a civil identity or government bearer-credential function makes this situation. The shared visual items and labelled number/date slots decide neither side alone.

A candidate passport or identity page collected under a work-authorization request is the shared evidence item. A requisition, candidate record and employer authorization workflow make the employer-side hiring situation; the government's credential structure makes the core-document situation. The holder's name or document number does not decide the branch.

Employee onboarding and right-to-work files can embed or reproduce government identity evidence. An employer form, employment role and onboarding workflow make the employment-record situation; a standalone government credential whose own purpose is to identify the person makes this situation. An identity-number slot alone counts for neither.

A coverage card and a government identity card both pair a person's name with an identifier and issuer. Plan, member, group and coverage labels make the insurance situation; an issuing-authority, credential-title and bearer-identity structure make this situation. A name beside a number or a card-shaped image discriminates nothing.

Loan and closing packets can contain identity scans, and loan applications can carry national identifiers in labelled slots. Lender, debt, amount and repayment structure make the loan situation; a credential whose own function is identifying a person makes this situation. A name or identifier is shared evidence and proves neither.

A driver credential and a vehicle registration can both be government-issued cards carrying a name, address, authority and opaque identifier. A credential identifies or authorizes a person; a registration or title identifies a vehicle and records ownership, registration or lien status. Authority and owner details prove neither template alone.

A phone photograph of a passport or identity card carries genuine camera EXIF, capture time and sometimes GPS. Those capture observations cannot decide its destination when OCR establishes a protected identity document. Document structure makes this situation; scene/event evidence makes the camera-event situation, and protection precedes placement.

A birth certificate or old passport scanned with family photographs shares scanner metadata, batch filenames and session context with the surrounding images. Civil-document structure in the member makes this situation; scene/person-history evidence and accepted archive context make the family-photo situation. The scan batch cannot sweep a protected record into a photo branch.

A sent identity image can arrive as a stripped, platform-named JPEG inside a messenger export. Conversation packaging makes the messenger situation; identity-document wording and labelled bearer structure in the image make this situation. The send context cannot lower protection or establish why the document was shared.

A passport or identity-card scan is genuinely a captured document, so scan geometry and OCR support both readings. Scanner/capture structure makes the scanned-document situation; core identity wording and labelled bearer slots make this situation. When the latter appears, the capture reading cannot become the file's proposed home.

A digital identity wallet or credential portal can be retained as a screenshot whose display metadata and software slots genuinely prove screen origin. Visible issuer, credential title and bearer structure make this protected situation; screen-origin evidence makes the screenshot situation. Screen origin cannot override identity protection or prove cryptographic validity.

A passport copy or citizenship certificate can sit inside a visa or immigration packet. The core document's own issuer-and-bearer structure makes this situation; application, permit, entry-record or adjudication structure makes the immigration situation. A passport alone does not establish an immigration workflow, and packet purpose is not copied onto it.

The words identity, credential, key and certificate collide across civil documents and authentication material. A government issuer, bearer and civil-status structure makes this situation; a key block, password-manager schema, recovery-code set or encrypted credential container makes the credentials situation. Certificate wording alone activates neither.

Birth, naturalization and name-change records can both establish identity/status and record a legal act or order. A document designed to prove who the bearer is makes this situation; a proceeding caption, party roles and operative order make the personal-legal situation. Both schemas may remain protected, but one seal, authority name or person name must not count twice.

falls_through_to.why: Core identity documents and address-book exports are exactly the isolated personal material this residual exists to protect. When no deeper user-accepted group exists, the safe broad home remains local and must not expose filenames or contents through model prompts.

sensitivity_why: This template contains direct identity evidence and contact graphs: bearer names, birth data, portraits, signatures, government identifiers, home addresses, contact methods and civil-status information. Safety activation therefore precedes any model or placement path, raw values remain local, and general summaries require redaction. The catalogue assigns only potentially_sensitive; it does not assign any P7 handling class or copy that vocabulary into the node.
open_question: The template deliberately leaves three product decisions open. May a protected identity area expose any default folder depth when the branch names themselves disclose document kinds or holder roles? If D1's field deferral ever lifts, should identity gain any stored fields at all, given that document numbers and civil attributes are among the corpus's sharpest raw values? May a local model inspect ambiguous protected documents by default, or must every model use require an explicit per-policy authorization? Until those decisions are made, this row remains field-less, dimension-less and closed to default cloud prompting.
